main_text.p: Præcept. Quibus deniq; eparestfrigidum, ventriculusq; eadem intemperie laborat, vel à nimio fragorum vsu abstinebunt, vel comedent ea ex vino cum saccharo & cinnamomo.
main_text.head: De prunis.
main_text.p: PRuna feré omnia pofi Catonem coepiffe certum eft. Plura funt eorum genera, sapore, calore, figura & magnitudine diftin-cta. Principatum obtinent Damascena, quorum quædam nigra sunt, quædam rubent, quædam violacea cernuntur. Sic appellata à celeberrima vrbe Damasco, alii vocant Syriaca: deportantur ficca in omnem feré terram, inq; coquinis magnatum non postremum tenent locum. Conficitur ex his confectio, quæ diaprunum appellatur, ad febres siccas commodissimum, ob humectandi & refrigerandi vim. Recentia omnia aluum laxant, emolliuntq;, insigniter enim humectant probè matura, immatura enim acerbiora sunt, unde ob acriorem quendam qui illis ineft, succu eumq; crudum, intestina vellicant, fluxumq; dysentericum excitant.
Eligenda autem quæ amplitudine, suavitate, saporisq; gratia commendantur, ea enim cæteris plura alunt, vino aut mulso incoctæ.

page.notes: Marginal note "Præcept." at top left. Catchword-like word "Verum" at foot of the page is printed as a running word at the bottom edge and is set as a foot line. Some letters in the scan are blurred, notably in "Damascena" and "Eligenda"; readings are provisional.
